benchmarks: empirical mean calibration contrast kernel with linear interpolation and flat extrapolation
config.forecast_estimator: Equal average of four independently fitted calibration exponential kernels, conditional on both measured target baselines; no target rate fit.
config.observation_model: Per-run affine raw absorbance against known nominal standard concentration. Independent Gaussian errors with a common variance within each run across standards and chamber samples; five standards do not establish this assumption.
config.primary_score: Mean absolute contrast error divided by each pair's initial corrected total, averaged over seven later times and then four target pairs.
config.publication_exposure: Published aggregate diffusivities, four automated-cohort diffusivities and qualitative method comparison known. No selected-cohort raw absorbance, calibration-standard values or notebook outputs inspected before this protocol.
config.reference_measure: Dissolved dye amount per compartment volume; equal-volume compartments also permit counting measure. Neither log-orthopolic nor linear-orthopolic size allocation.
config.stock_score: Separate sampling-adjusted total-stock residual covariance test; not inferred from a kinetic benchmark win.

assumptions: Nominal optical-standard concentrations are known without error.
Raw absorbance errors are independent Gaussian with a common variance for standards and chamber samples within each run.
Five standards do not establish linearity, temporal stability, matrix equivalence, Gaussian errors, or equal variances.
Sampling removes and replaces 0.02 mL simultaneously in both 11 mL chambers; observations precede collection.
The reference measure is compartment volume, neither log-orthopolic nor linear-orthopolic size allocation.
